basic_details.short_information: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham has invited applications for 1 Resident Staff Nurse – Male vacancy in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh for its 2026 recruitment. content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the educational qualification and professional requirements specified by the campus. Applicants must hold a valid nursing license/registration. Proven experience in hospital, clinic, or home healthcare is preferred. Candidates are also required to have knowledge of emergency care procedures, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and must be physically fit and emotionally resilient.

content_sections.heading: Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham Resident Staff Nurse – Male Job Description
content_sections.text: The duties and responsibilities for the Resident Staff Nurse – Male position include: Assess and monitor patients’ health conditions. Administer medications and treatments as prescribed by physicians. Record and maintain accurate patient medical records. Assist doctors during examinations and medical procedures. Provide emergency medical care when required. Educate patients and families about treatment plans and health management. Maintain hygiene, safety, and infection control standards. Support bedridden or elderly patients with daily activities. Coordinate with healthcare teams for effective patient care. Monitor vital signs such as blood pressure, pulse, temperature, and oxygen levels. Ensure medical equipment is properly maintained and sterilised.
